journey: Cross-tenant isolation on a live foreign lease

narrative.step: tenant A opens a real runner and it is HELD
tenant A can read its OWN lease (positive control — the id is genuinely live)
narrative.assertion: owner reads it: 200 held (id is a real, existing lease)

narrative.step: tenant B tries to read tenant A's LIVE lease → 404, no oracle
narrative.assertion: tenant B GET A's live lease → 404 (must be 404 — isolation holds)

narrative.step: tenant B tries to CLOSE tenant A's live lease → refused
narrative.assertion: tenant B close A's lease → 404 (cannot mutate another tenant's lease)

narrative.step: tenant B's own lease list does NOT contain A's lease
narrative.assertion: tenant B list has 0 leases, none is A's (no leakage)

narrative.step: tenant A's lease is still intact after B's attempts (B could not tamper)
narrative.assertion: A's lease still HELD after B's probes (untampered)
